long_description:
Join Yess Yoga for a series of free art and wellness programs at Mia. Quarterly classes will explore different yoga practices in connection to Mia’s collection. Participants will enjoy 45-60 minutes of yoga before exploring Mia’s galleries. Mia will have a few mats available for use, but we encourage you to bring your own mat and props if able.

Register for free: https://bit.ly/4q3yYHZ

Tickets are released at 9:30 am on the 15th of the month prior to each program.

Program Details:

January 15 | Where Breath Meets Sound

Time: 6–8 p.m.

Location: Target Reception Hall

This class begins with a 60-minute yoga practice incorporating monastic chanting. After the class, enjoy a guided tour of Mia’s special exhibition, “Royal Bronzes: Cambodian Art of the Divine.” Entry to the exhibition is included with your reservation.

March 5 | Root to Rise

Time: 6–8 p.m.

Location: Target Reception Hall

Try yin yoga before exploring the exhibition “Intimate Details of the Natural World: Botanical Art of Minnesota from the Eloise Butler Wildflower Garden and Bird Sanctuary Florilegium.”

June 6 | Head, Shoulders, Knees, and Toes

Time: 10:30 a.m.–12:30 p.m.

Location: Target Park (weather permitting; rain location: Target Reception Hall)

Class details coming soon!

October 8 | Tea and Reiki

Time: 6–8 p.m.

Location: Target Reception Hall

Class details coming soon!
